title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Claim Tolerance by Shopper Level and Service Length
content:
In a mileage dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the claim tolerance is the percentage by which the estimated route is grown: the miles driven must exceed the estimated route grown by it for anything to be claimed, and only the miles driven beyond that grown estimate are counted. The claim tolerance follows the shopper's contractor account in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts:

- **5 percent** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **10 percent** for an account at the Silver level or above (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **the batch type's mileage dispute tolerance** for every other account — 0 percent for the Shop-Only Batch and 15 percent for the Express 30 Batch, Single Delivery Batch, Double Delivery Batch, Triple Delivery Batch and Stock-Up Batch.

The level and the first activation date are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record; the months are whole calendar months up to the handling date.

## Combinations

| Level | Whole months since first activation | Claim tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 5 percent |
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 12 to 35 | 10 percent |
| Silver | 12 to 35 | 10 percent |
| Silver | 36 or more | The batch type's tolerance |
| Any | Fewer than 12 | The batch type's tolerance |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | Any | The batch type's tolerance |

## Hypothetical routes (estimated route 8.0 miles, 9.0 miles driven)

| Claim tolerance | Grown estimate | Does 9.0 exceed it? | Miles beyond |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 percent | 8.4 | Yes | 0.6 |
| 10 percent | 8.8 | Yes | 0.2 |
| 15 percent | 9.2 | No | — |
